scope: Generic ordered execution of captured BehaviorRecord entrypoints and Modifier _CallbackList callbacks; not a claim of complete native event-bus equivalence.

evidence.support: source task arrays preserve sibling order; Black Swan callbacks include explicit Event and Priority values -11 and 200
ordinary action completion, HP/resource/AV boundaries are already documented as deterministic packet boundaries

selected_model.registration: Each active behavior/modifier contributes callbacks keyed by source Event. Registration identity is {owner_instance, behavior_id, modifier_id?, callback_index}; duplicate registration is rejected unless a modifier lifecycle packet explicitly replaces it.
selected_model.dispatch_order: For one emitted Event, select currently active registrations, sort by numeric Priority ascending (missing Priority = 0), then stable registration sequence ascending. This is selected because Black Swan -11 setup precedes priority 200 cleanup in the same OnPhase1 family; it is R3, not local runtime proof.
selected_model.entrypoint_order: Within an entrypoint or CallbackConfig, execute source operation order depth-first. Nested SuccessTaskList/FailedTaskList/TaskList/Retarget.TaskList/template children retain their explicit parent-child field path and order.
selected_model.state_visibility: A state-mutating compiled primitive commits before the following sibling operation and before the next callback registration is evaluated. State visibility between operations is therefore deterministic; atomic multi-write rules remain primitive-packet responsibilities.
selected_model.nested_dispatch: An operation may emit a nested Event. It is appended to a FIFO event queue after the currently executing operation; the current entrypoint completes before the next queued event begins. Immediate-vs-deferred native differences remain an explicit ambiguity whenever they affect a published observable.
selected_model.cancellation: No global cancellation model is accepted yet. A future primitive may return CANCEL_CURRENT_EVENT or CANCEL_REMAINING_CALLBACKS only with an explicit source/semantic packet; otherwise no cancellation is inferred.
selected_model.completion_markers: ACTION_START_MARKER, DAMAGE_COMPLETION_MARKER and ACTION_COMPLETION_MARKER are ordered event boundaries, not presentation no-ops. Their scheduler effects remain dependent on action/timeline packets.

state_reads: current BattleState at each operation boundary
state_writes: callback registration changes only through modifier lifecycle
unsupported: native listener priority proof beyond the selected model
all event names and special mode dispatch phases
acceptance: A compiler/kernel test must register Black Swan-style callbacks with priorities -11/0/200, execute ordered nested child task traces, preserve source order for Monster and StageBuff entrypoints, and reject behavior-affecting OPAQUE nodes rather than skipping them.
dsh_implementation_contract: Implement a deterministic EventQueue with stable registration sequence, priority ascending, FIFO nested events, depth-first entrypoint children, explicit trace records and no implicit cancellation. Keep this packet scoped until coverage tests prove wider source families.
